title: Myriad Aggregation
text: Begin Myriad Aggregation in the Miniature World Framework. Both starting routes consume the Crystallized Philosopher’s Stone.
The miniature world evolves through the Overworld, Nether and End before collapsing into an Omni Microcore. The framework projection and JEI show the offerings for each stage.
Dimension crossings and the final collapse clear leftover materials. The microcore remains inside until taken; only then does the frame reset.
